text:
Nadia P.: Quick brain-dump from the design pairing this morning. we need a rollout metadata shape that can express: region-scoped pins, hardware affinity (gpu type), multi-cohort weights, and short-lived operator overrides. who wants to flag obvious pitfalls? @Tom W. on size/encoding, @Diego on resolution semantics.

Tom W.: Biggest ops risk is manifest churn. if every tenant writes full per-variant docs we end up with massive manifests. options: 1) base manifest + delta patches (apply-on-read), 2) compact bitflags + lookup table for common cases. proto+gz compresses well.

Diego: Semantics notes: "pin" has at least 3 orthogonal axes: scope (global|tenant|region), mode (hard|soft|prefer), and affinity (hardware id or label). resolution must consider scope precedence and recency for same precedence. propose canonical priority tuple: (mode_rank, scope_rank, recency_ts).

Lina H.: Client compatibility: any schema with new fields MUST be namespaced under `rollout.schema_v1` so old servers can ignore. clients that opt-in get `strict_mode` where pins are authoritative. default behavior remains permissive fallback. also suggest a feature gate `enable_strict_pinning` for gradual rollout.

Nadia P.: Example manifest sketch (compact JSON for readability):

```
{
  "rollout": {
    "schema_v1": {
      "variants": [
        {"id":"vA","w":50,"pins":[{"scope":"tenant:acme","mode":"hard","affinity":["a100","g5"],"ttl":3600}]},
        {"id":"vB","w":50,"pins":[{"scope":"region:eu-west","mode":"prefer","affinity":[],"ttl":0}]}
      ],
      "deltas": [
        {"op":"patch","target":"vB","change":{"w":60},"since":3470009000}
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Tom W.: Love `deltas`. note: gateway should be able to apply deltas incrementally, but that adds CPU cost on read. we can precompute merged manifests in a cache for hot tenants. also recommend keeping `affinity` as label set (strings) not raw hardware ids to avoid churn when infra names change.

Diego: Conflict resolution pseudocode:

```
collect candidate pins for request (global + tenant + region)
filter by affinity match (if request has hw_label)
sort by (mode_priority, scope_priority, recency)
if top is hard => choose its variant
if top is soft/prefer => blend with variant weights (adjusted)
else fallback to weight-based selection
```

Lina H.: Important: telemetry must record `pin_evaluation_trace` (small encoded list) returned in debug headers so clients can see which pin applied. also a metric `pin_evaluations_per_min` and `pin_conflicts` per-tenant.

Nadia P.: One tricky edge: regional rollouts + autoscaler anti-affinity. e.g., tenant pins region=us-west but autoscaler spreads load to other region GPUs. we need an enforcement signal at routing layer and a best-effort soft drain when enforcement can't be satisfied. capture as `enforcement_level` on pin (enforced|best_effort).

Tom W.: For wire encoding, we should support both: readable JSON for debug UI and a compact protobuf variant for runtime. proto schema should have a `oneof` for `delta` vs `full` to simplify parsing.

Diego: Migration plan: support `rollout.legacy` and `rollout.schema_v1` concurrently. nodes reading manifests should respect `schema` field and prefer the highest version they understand. roll servers in this order: control-plane writers (accept new fields) -> readers/gateways -> clients opt-in. add an infra deploy CUE that asserts no gateway in the pool is older than X before flipping strict mode.

reconcile-bot: NOTE: scheduling a reconciliation pass for tenants with conflicting pins. queued: 37 tenants. will emit per-tenant report to `eng-runtime` next hour.

infra-bot: DEPLOY NOTE: adding `schema_v1` will touch: rollout-service, gateway, routing-filter, and telemetry-ingest. suggest staged rollout by region. tagging `infra/rollout-schema` and `eng-runtime`.

Nadia P.: Action items: Tom -> proto vs json perf microbench (Wed EOD), Diego -> formalize priority tuple + pseudo-RFC (Thu), Lina -> feature gate + debug header spec, infra -> plan staged deploy. i'll draft short RFC with examples + migration checklist after microbench results. thanks :rocket:
